title: Umakhi Wezithiyo
intro: Emazweni amakhulu, umuntu onamandla waqala uchungechunge lwezimpi, wanikeza igunya elikhulu kanye nezindlela. Lo mphefumulo wahlangana nemiphakathi eyahlukahlukene futhi wabhekana nezinselele ezihlukile, washiya uphawu oluhlala njalo emlandweni nasokholweni ngezenzo zawo nokuhlakanipha kwawo, konke lokhu ngenkathi eqaphela umthombo wangempela wamandla awo.
clues: Nganikwa amandla nezindlela phezu kwakho konke, futhi ngalandela indlela.
Uhambo lwami lwangiyisa endaweni eshona ilanga, lapho ngathola khona abantu.
Ngihlangane nomphakathi owawungaqondi kahle inkulumo, ohlala phakathi kwezintaba ezimbili.
Ngacelwa ukuba ngakhe isithiyo, hhayi ngenxa yenzuzo yami, kodwa ukuze ngivikele emandleni abhubhisayo.
Ngamemezela ukuthi amandla okwakha lolu donga olukhulu avela ku-Allah, futhi luzohlala kuze kube yisikhathi esithembisiwe.
Igama lami, elivame ukuhunyushwa ngokuthi 'Onezimpondo Ezimbili,' lisho ukufinyelela kwami ​​emhlabeni wonke noma mhlawumbe izinkathi ezimbili ezihlukene.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
